scripts.dev: docker compose up -d && concurrently -n api,web,billing -c magenta,cyan,yellow "pnpm --dir apps/api start:dev" "pnpm --dir apps/web dev" "pnpm --dir apps/billing dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --dir apps/api build && pnpm --dir apps/web build && pnpm --dir apps/billing build
scripts.lint: pnpm --dir apps/api lint && pnpm --dir apps/web lint && pnpm --dir apps/billing lint
